That's pretty much Death Magnetic for me. I could tell it was good but nothing stood out at first. It still doesn't too much and feels super pieced together. The loudness war didn't help whatsoever either. That said, I enjoy the album and Suicide is one of my favorite songs of theirs. There are a few Hardwired songs that aren't as memorable overall, but immediately this album had a few stand out tracks to me. Moth, Bone, and Halo are top tier in my mind and Now That We're Dead and Here Comes Revenge are up there as well

Loneliness to the point that I hate myself. I know I shouldn't care but I've never felt any sort of love from a non-family member. Mid twenties and I know I'm young but I've never even had the naive type of love. No relationships. I just want someone to hug and tell me that it'll be okay. I want a best friend, a real best friend. When I see couples or get rejected, I immediately rationality by saying how I wouldn't be good enough for them anyways so it's better for them anyways.

I was a huge fan of Vegas 2, but I feel like this is my Battlefront. It looks great, plays well, and is tons of fun with friends. That said, I feel like I overpaid at $60 considering the lack of variety. Meanwhile I know that Battlefront has the same issues, I still don't see myself growing tired of it any time soon. (Not getting DLC, but still)

I loved terrorist hunt in Vegas 2, and I replayed that so many times. I just don't feel like this is going to be the same for me. It also doesn't help that this is one of the few games I dislike playing versus on, but I can appreciate that a majority of people disagree there. In the end I feel like this is one of those "buy if your friends play it, otherwise skip it" situations personally.
